_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd thefront/egg-the-front.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence). Octail adds the the-front tag, automatic beacon, query and shutdown-service ports instead of fixed defaults (upstream gave query and shutdown the same 27017), the Steam query (A2S) for player counts, the no_console_input flag (the server reads no console commands), install sandbox defaults and resource hints, refuses double quotes and backslashes in the server name, limits the config name to letters, digits, - and _ (it is a folder name), the password to one word, admins to Steam IDs and tags to the documented numbers, stops with Ctrl+C (upstream's ^^C was a kill), and makes the install fail when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration". SteamCMD exits 0 even when an install failed (Missing configuration), so its retry loop counts a run as done only on SteamCMD's "Success! App" line.
name: The Front
author: eggs@goover.dev
description: The Front is a survival open-world crafting shooter. You play the role of a resistance fighter sent back in time to stop the rise of a tyrannical empire.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd Base Installation Script
#
clear
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m'

echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"
echo -e "${YELLOW}The Front  Installscript${NC}"
echo -e "${YELLOW}Egg by gOOvER | https://goover.dev${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"

#apt -y update
#apt -y --no-install-recommends install curl lib32gcc-s1 ca-certificates jq dos2unix

echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"
echo -e "${YELLOW}download and install steamcmd. please wait...${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"

## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server
echo -e "${GREEN}..done..${NC}"

## install game using steamcmd
echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"
echo -e "${YELLOW}install game using steamcmd. please wait...${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"

## other flags may be needed depending on install. looking at you cs 1.6
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update 1007 +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log && grep -q "Success! App '" /tmp/steamcmd.log && ! grep -q "ERROR! Failed to install app" /tmp/steamcmd.log; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done
echo -e "${GREEN}..done..${NC}"

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/ProjectWar/Binaries/Linux/TheFrontServer" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the The Front dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi
chmod +x /mnt/server/ProjectWar/Binaries/Linux/TheFrontServer

## install end
echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"
echo -e "${GREEN}Installation completed...${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"

variables.name: [SERVER] Server Name
variables.description: The name in the server list (no double quotes or backslashes).

variables.name: [SERVER] Max Players
variables.description: The max number of players on your server.

variables.name: [SERVER] Config Name
variables.description: Name of the save (a folder in TheFrontManager/): letters, digits, - and _ only.

variables.name: [SERVER] Server Password
variables.description: Optional: players must enter it to join. One word, no quotes.

variables.name: [SERVER] PvE
variables.description: off = PvP; on = PvE

variables.name: [SERVER] Use Steam Socket
variables.description: Use Steam servers for network penetration. Enable this if you don't have a public IP but you want to allow players from outside your network to join your server. If disabled, only you and other players on your LAN can join. If you have a public IP, you do not need to enable this. Enabling this feature will affect latency. When Steam servers are busy, you may not be able to join this server.

variables.name: [SERVER] Damage self?
variables.description: Allows players to damage themselves.

variables.name: [SERVER] Damage allies?
variables.description: Allows squadmates to damage each other.

variables.name: [SERVER] Server Admins
variables.description: Enter a 17-digit Steam ID. Use semicolons between each ID. GM level defaults to highest level (Lv. 25)

variables.name: [ADVANCED] Label admin
variables.description: Toggles special admin icon.

variables.name: [ADVANCED] Server save interval
variables.description: Server archive interval (in seconds)

variables.name: [ADVANCED] Enable novice protection?
variables.description: When enabled, new characters will receive novice protection.

variables.name: [ADVANCED] Server Tags
variables.description: Up to 5 tag numbers separated by commas, e.g. 1,4: 0 = PvP, 1 = PvE, 2 = EXP multiplier, 3 = gathering rate, 4 = keep inventory, 5 = 45-day wipe, 6 = 15-day wipe, 7 = 30-day wipe, 8 = 60-day wipe.

variables.name: [ADVANCED] Enable anticheat?
variables.description: Toggles anticheat.

variables.name: [ADVANCED] Enable profanity?
variables.description: When disable, profanity will be blocked.

variables.name: [SERVER] Auto Update
variables.description: Autoupdate your Server on start/restart

variables.name: [SERVER] BeaconPort
variables.description: Set by Octail when the server is created (one after the game port).

variables.name: [SERVER] QueryPort
variables.description: Set by Octail when the server is created (two after the game port).

variables.name: [SERVER] ShutDownServicePort
variables.description: Set by Octail when the server is created (three after the game port).

variables.name: WINDOWS_INSTALL
variables.description: DO NOT REMOVE !!!
